meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 处理 git 操作时,Claude 会先分析仓库状态与历史,按仓库现有语言和风格把改动拆成多个原子提交;改动文件多时会强制增加提交数,并指导 rebase/squash 与历史查找。
howto.when: 当用户进行任何 git 操作时触发,典型入口包括提到“commit”“rebase”“squash”等关键词,或询问某段代码何时/由谁写入。

say.text: 帮我把这次改动按目录拆成几个提交,再逐个提交
say.note: Claude 会先分析文件,给出分组提交计划。

say.text: 用 rebase 把这几个 commit 合并成一个,并解决冲突
say.note: Claude 会先检查是否已推送再重写。

say.text: 查一下这行代码是什么时候加的、谁写的
say.note: Claude 会用 log/blame 定位历史。

howto.what_en: For git tasks, Claude first inspects the repo state and history, mirrors the repo's commit language/style, splits changes into multiple atomic commits, and gives step-by-step guidance for rebase/squash rewrites and history lookups.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any git operation, e.g. mentioning 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or asking who wrote code / when a line was added.

say_en.text: Split these changes by directory and make separate commits.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes files and proposes a split plan.

say_en.text: Rebase and squash these commits into one, resolving conflicts.
say_en.note: Claude checks push state before rewriting.

say_en.text: Find when this line was added and who wrote it.
say_en.note: Claude uses log/blame to trace history.
